Subject: Security intake: SOC 2 / trust portal access (MedixHealth)

Hi Sanjay — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep procurement moving.

Recap (from our discovery):
- MedixHealth will process PHI for the pilot; HIPAA-BAA will be required for production.
- Security team needs SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) + bridge letter covering controls since report date.
- They want access to a trust portal or secure evidence share for on-demand artifacts and to kick off a short vendor security questionnaire (VSQ).

Action items I can own from Redwood:
1) Share SOC 2 Type II PDF and a short bridge letter stub explaining our report coverage and date.
2) Provide a trust-portal link and a scoped read-only account for MedixHealth security reviewers.
3) Start the VSQ (we typically send a pre-filled section for vendor info and then security receives an invite).
4) Confirm HIPAA/BAA process and provide our standard DPA/BAA steps.

Can you confirm the primary security contact for the VSQ and an estimated timeline for procurement review? Procurement copied here — what cadence works for you?

I attached our vendor onboarding packet and a one-page SOC 2 summary for quick review. If useful, Evelyn can jump in to do a short walkthrough of the portal and answers to technical questions.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I received the portal invites and was able to review the redacted SOC 2 report and the mapping spreadsheet. A few remaining questions for Redwood before we close the vendor security review: 

1) Can you confirm the date range covered by the SOC 2 Type II report and whether any subservice providers were added after the report period? Please reflect this in the bridge letter.
2) We need to see whether logging retention for access audit logs meets our 12-month lookback requirement — is that documented in a policy PDF in the portal? If not, can you provide the relevant evidence or statement of retention?
3) Regarding HIPAA: good to know Redwood executes a BAA. Can you confirm if Redwood will accept our redlines to Section 7 (breach notification timeline) and to the limitations of liability for PHI? If legal needs to discuss redlines, please route to laura.bennett@redwood.ai and I will loop our counsel.

If those items are addressed quickly, procurement should be able to finalize within the 10-business-day window. We’d like the bridge letter and retention evidence by EOD Fri 24 Jul if possible.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Security Manager, MedixHealth
